dashboard_description: Key social impact metrics at a glance
methodology_subtitle: How this dashboard collects and presents data
methodology_text: This dashboard presents key social impact indicators based on university ESG metrics.
methodology_data_collection_text: Data is collected from university departments using a standardized Excel template. The template includes five sheets: Meta, Gender, Engagement, Volunteering, and ESG Courses. Each sheet has required and optional fields to ensure data consistency while allowing flexibility.
methodology_validation_text: Every uploaded file undergoes automated validation before it can be published:
methodology_validation_1: Year fields must be valid integers
methodology_validation_2: Percentage fields must be between 0 and 100
methodology_validation_3: Count and hour fields must be non-negative
methodology_validation_5: Unknown columns generate warnings but do not block upload
methodology_calculations_text: Summary KPIs are computed as averages (for percentages) or totals (for counts and hours) across all records matching the selected filters. Gender distributions show the average male/female percentages. Engagement metrics show average satisfaction and NPS. Volunteering combines student and staff volunteers into totals.
methodology_versioning_text: Each upload creates a versioned dataset. Admins can preview, publish, or rollback to any valid version. When a new dataset is published, connected dashboard clients receive an instant notification via Server-Sent Events (SSE) and automatically refresh their data.
methodology_esg_framework_text: This dashboard focuses on the Social pillar of ESG, covering four key dimensions: Gender Balance & Diversity, Student/Staff Engagement, Volunteering & Social Projects, and ESG Courses & Awareness. These dimensions align with UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) including SDG 4 (Quality Education), SDG 5 (Gender Equality), and SDG 10 (Reduced Inequalities).
no_data_description: Upload and publish an Excel file from the Admin panel to see your metrics here.
hero_description: A comprehensive analytics platform tracking Environmental, Social & Governance metrics across university faculties. Monitor gender equity, student engagement, volunteering activity, and ESG curriculum coverage — all in real-time.
method_step_1_desc: Standardized Excel template distributed to all university faculties with required and optional fields.
method_step_1_inputs: University department list, ESG field definitions
method_step_1_outputs: Blank template (.xlsx) with 5 sheets: Meta, Gender, Engagement, Volunteering, ESG Courses
method_step_2_desc: Faculties fill in the template with annual social metrics per department.
method_step_2_inputs: Departmental HR records, student surveys, volunteer logs
method_step_2_outputs: Filled Excel files per faculty per year
method_step_3_desc: Admin uploads the Excel file to the system. Backend parses each sheet into structured records.
method_step_4_desc: Automated rules check data integrity: types, ranges, required fields, and consistency.
method_step_4_outputs: Error list (blocking), warning list (non-blocking), validation score
method_step_5_desc: Validated data is stored as a versioned draft. Multiple drafts can exist simultaneously.
method_step_5_outputs: Draft dataset with version ID, timestamp, upload history
method_step_6_desc: Admin previews the draft data, checks KPI summaries, and decides to publish or rollback.
method_step_7_desc: The selected draft becomes the active dataset. Previous active version is archived.
method_step_7_outputs: Published dataset marked as active, archived previous version
method_step_8_desc: Server-Sent Events notify all connected dashboard clients of the new publication instantly.
method_step_8_outputs: Real-time push notification to all connected browsers
method_step_9_desc: Clients receive the event, re-fetch data, and render updated charts, KPIs, and tables.
method_step_9_outputs: Updated dashboard with live metrics, charts, and export capabilities
method_step_1_purpose: Ensure all faculties use a consistent data format for reliable aggregation.
method_step_1_criteria: Template received and acknowledged by all faculties
method_step_2_purpose: Gather raw social metrics from each department for the reporting year.
method_step_2_tools: Excel, departmental HR systems, survey tools
method_step_2_criteria: All required fields populated, no blank mandatory cells
method_step_3_purpose: Convert spreadsheet data into structured records the system can process.
method_step_3_criteria: File parsed without critical errors, all sheets recognized
method_step_4_purpose: Catch data quality issues before they reach the dashboard.
method_step_4_criteria: 0 blocking errors, warnings documented and non-blocking
method_step_5_purpose: Preserve a complete audit trail of every data submission.
method_step_5_criteria: Draft stored with unique version ID, timestamp, and upload context
method_step_6_purpose: Give admins full visibility before making data public.
method_step_6_tools: Admin panel preview, KPI summary view
method_step_6_criteria: Admin confirms data accuracy and approves for publication
method_step_7_purpose: Make the approved data live for all dashboard consumers.
method_step_7_tools: Admin panel publish button, database swap
method_step_7_criteria: New version marked active, previous version archived
method_step_8_purpose: Notify all connected clients immediately when new data is available.
method_step_8_criteria: All connected clients receive the publication event
method_step_9_purpose: Deliver updated visualizations to end-users without page reload.
method_step_9_criteria: Charts, KPIs, and tables reflect the latest published dataset
